::: content
In the recent issue of `<cite>`{=html}MAA Focus`</cite>`{=html} [Ivars Peterson](http://ivarspeterson.googlepages.com/) gets a [look at Integral House](http://www.maa.org/pubs/augsept09pgs4-6.pdf), the home of James Stewart, aka the man who wrote the most popular [calculus](/categories/calculus/){.alinks-link} book in the world.

[![](http://www.maa.org/images/interior01.jpg){width="375"}](http://www.maa.org/news/061809stewart.html)

The house features sweeping curves (natch) and is custom even down to the door handles:

[\
![](http://i203.photobucket.com/albums/aa27/leingang_math/StewartIntegralHouseDoorHandle.png){border="0"}\
](http://s203.photobucket.com/albums/aa27/leingang_math/?action=view&current=StewartIntegralHouseDoorHandle.png "StewartIntegralHouseDoorHandle.png")

I guess math pays after all!
:::
